scope: Re-evaluate the existing Gaia registration evidence using actual finite image footprints; no motion or gravity targets.
wcs: Explicit undistorted RA---TAN/DEC--TAN with complete 2x2 CD matrix; reject other projections and nondefault pole conventions. SIP is not applied, and this choice is inherited from the previous calibration-only selection.
footprint: All pixels in the 7x7 patch around the rounded Gaia position must be finite. A finite zero is not missing exposure. This tests finite footprint only, not a calibrated exposure-weight mask.
detection_replay: Exactly replay previous image-only high-pass sigma=3 pixel, truncate=4, reflect boundary; 5x5 local maxima above 8 robust global sigma; positive 3x3 weighted centroid, four-pixel border exclusion.

association_diagnostic.purpose: Measure matched-star fraction and chance association rate, without labeling a truncated residual distribution a full registration validation.

claim_limits: Footprint adjustment is a development repair, not fresh confirmation.
Undetected optical Gaia stars are not automatically astrometric failures in an infrared image.
P1/IRAC flux-map astrometry does not validate transfer to cleaned P5 stellar maps.
No full 3D mass model or gravity score follows from this audit alone.
